## Configuration

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
import sys

import pandas as pd

root = Path.cwd()
if root.name == "notebooks":
    root = root.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))

from ards_cxr_benchmark.annotation_reference import (
    annotation_agreement_summary,
    build_case_reference_standard,
    case_level_disagreement_flags,
    clean_rater_ratings,
    leave_one_rater_out_agreement,
    rater_pairwise_agreement,
    render_annotation_summary_markdown,
    strip_unsafe_columns,
    validate_rating_dataframe,
    write_rating_validation,
)
from ards_cxr_benchmark.config import ensure_dir, ensure_parent_dir

annotation_path = Path(
    os.environ.get(
        "ARDS_PROB_ANNOTATIONS",
        root / "tests" / "fixtures" / "probabilistic_annotations.csv",
    )
)
synthetic_mode = "ARDS_PROB_ANNOTATIONS" not in os.environ
annotation_output_root = root / "data" / "derived" / "annotations"
annotation_artifact_root = root / "artifacts" / "annotations"
if synthetic_mode:
    annotation_output_root = annotation_output_root / "synthetic"
    annotation_artifact_root = annotation_artifact_root / "synthetic"
ratings_out = annotation_output_root / "validated_rater_ratings.parquet"
reference_out = annotation_output_root / "case_reference_standard.parquet"
artifact_dir = annotation_artifact_root

annotation_path
```

## Load Completed Ratings

```{python}
ratings_raw = pd.read_parquet(annotation_path) if annotation_path.suffix == ".parquet" else pd.read_csv(annotation_path)
strip_unsafe_columns(ratings_raw).head()
```

## Validate Schema And Ranges

```{python}
validation = validate_rating_dataframe(ratings_raw)
validation.to_dict()
```

```{python}
if not validation.passed:
    raise ValueError(validation.to_dict())
```

## Build Case-Level Reference Standard

```{python}
ratings = clean_rater_ratings(ratings_raw)
reference = build_case_reference_standard(ratings)
reference
```

## Continuous Rater Agreement

```{python}
agreement = annotation_agreement_summary(ratings, reference)
pairwise = rater_pairwise_agreement(ratings)
leave_one_out = leave_one_rater_out_agreement(ratings)
disagreement = case_level_disagreement_flags(reference)

agreement
```

```{python}
pairwise
```

```{python}
leave_one_out
```

## Export Text-Stripped Artifacts

```{python}
ensure_dir(artifact_dir)
ensure_parent_dir(ratings_out)
ensure_parent_dir(reference_out)

ratings.to_parquet(ratings_out, index=False)
reference.to_parquet(reference_out, index=False)
write_rating_validation(validation, out_json=artifact_dir / "annotation_validation_summary.json")
agreement.to_csv(artifact_dir / "annotation_agreement_summary.csv", index=False)
pairwise.to_csv(artifact_dir / "rater_pairwise_agreement.csv", index=False)
disagreement.to_csv(artifact_dir / "case_level_disagreement_flags.csv", index=False)
(artifact_dir / "annotation_agreement_summary.md").write_text(
    render_annotation_summary_markdown(
        validation=validation,
        agreement_summary=agreement,
        pairwise_agreement=pairwise,
        leave_one_out=leave_one_out,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)

{
    "ratings_out": str(ratings_out),
    "reference_out": str(reference_out),
    "artifact_dir": str(artifact_dir),
}
```
